news.title: Daily pass: 485 verified additions (R3561–R4045), 116 from the review list
news.detail: Retry list first: 116 leads promoted from the Leads to review list (R3561–R3676) — 97 whose 2026-11-19 retry evidence was re-confirmed today (Wayback copies of TRID/repository record pages, CiNii Books/Research records, Open Library edition records incl. Neville, Properties of Concrete 3rd and 4th ed., and PCA Design and Control of Concrete Mixtures 13th ed.) and 19 that opened today via repository APIs (DSpace 7 REST, Sikt NVA, DiVA MODS export) or Wayback copies. 61 leads stay on the review list (47 still unavailable after another retry, 14 new). Discovery then added 369 verified sources for the rotation head — mix design, cement chemistry, mechanics, limestone, alkali-activated binders, durability, architectural, self-compacting, polymer/refractory, recycled-aggregate, pavement/pervious, repair/grout/overlay and precast/3D-printed concrete — with 66 records from backward and 29 from forward citation chases, 79 non-English records (English glosses) and 25 dated 2026. Mostly DOI/abstract or record-page level, not full-text reviews. Review list: https://xxdccole.github.io/Type1L-Index/review/

change.entry: Daily pass 2026-11-20: 485 verified additions R3561–R4045. Retry list first: 116 promoted from research/review-retry.jsonl (R3561–R3676; 97 re-confirmed promotable, 19 opened on today's retry), 47 still unavailable (lastTried 2026-11-20, attempts +1). Discovery: 383 new leads checked — 369 promoted (R3677–R4045), 14 qualified-but-unavailable added to the review list, 0 rejected after screening (11 hits excluded at screening as off-topic/non-sources), 0 left open. No corrections to existing records. R1–R3560 preserved (R428 still retired); topic membership union maintained.

gap: Daily pass 2026-11-20: additions are registry/catalogue/record-page verified (102 abstract-level, 244 DOI metadata only, 112 record pages read incl. Wayback copies and repository APIs, 27 library catalogue records) — not full-text reviewed. 61 qualified leads remain on the review list (research/review-retry.md; https://xxdccole.github.io/Type1L-Index/review/): mainly CNKI/CQVIP Chinese articles, TRID records with no Wayback copy, Theseus (Cloudflare challenge), yadda/BazTech, ResearchGate-only items and a few unregistered DOIs. Architectural and polymer/refractory title queries drifted to GFRP/FRP literature (re-tagged); both topics stay thin. The FHWA UHPC state-of-the-art report is already indexed (R155).

takeaways.cross-mix: Nov 20 backfill: aggregate grading (Furnas 1931 maximum-density relations), paste volume and protected paste volume, mix proportioning of HPC, alkali-activated and recycled-aggregate concretes, genetic-algorithm/ANN proportioning, air-entraining and water-reducing admixtures and polycarboxylate charge density (R3594–R4038, 73 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.cross-chemistry: Nov 20 backfill: C-S-H structure and solubility models (Taylor/Richardson, Jennings, 29Si NMR, infrared), alite/tricalcium silicate hydration kinetics and nucleation seeding, pore-solution chemistry (temperature, alkali-activated binders), Powers-era cement-paste structure papers and retry-list classics (Longuet pore solution, Copeland & Hayes non-evaporable water) (R3581–R4029, 67 records). Not full-text reviewed.
takeaways.cross-mechanics: Nov 20 backfill: fracture and size effect (Bažant 2019 book, Kaplan 1961, Hillerborg-era notch sensitivity, Griffith criterion), strain-rate effects in compression and tension, multiaxial and confined stress–strain models (Mander-type, FRP-confined), fatigue of plain and fibre-reinforced concrete, autogenous and drying shrinkage, creep/relaxation (R3562–R4037, 117 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.scm-limestone: Nov 20 backfill: limestone fineness and early hydration, limestone fines in manufactured sand and SCC, limestone with fly ash/slag/alkali-activated blends, nano-/micro-limestone in UHPC, intergrinding of clinker and limestone (1990s), Portland-limestone cement TG and low-temperature sulfate studies and a 2026 PLC infrastructure paper (R3699–R3995, 15 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.binder-activated: Nov 20 backfill: Handbook of Alkali-Activated Cements (2015), fly-ash geopolymer mortars (NaOH, curing temperature, nano-silica, ambient curing), sodium carbonate/silicate-activated slag setting, geopolymer acid resistance, retry-list Nordic F-concrete and Spanish activated-slag thesis, Czech alkali-activated bridge thesis, Martian-regolith and recycled-powder geopolymers (2026) (R3561–R4021, 36 records). Not full-text reviewed.
takeaways.cross-durability: Nov 20 backfill: chloride binding and chloride threshold reviews, sea-sand/seawater concrete and FRP bars in seawater concrete, calcium leaching, carbonation-depth prediction, biogenic sulfuric-acid (sewer) corrosion, salt scaling, ASR mitigation with SCMs, colour change and image analysis of fire-damaged concrete, retry-list chloride/carbonation reports (R3580–R4038, 90 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.concrete-architectural: Nov 20 backfill (thin): GFRC durability and ageing, textile-reinforced concrete façades (LCA, sandwich elements, surface finish), service-life prediction of architectural concrete façades, precast/PV and double-skin façade LCAs and surface-finish quality in 3D printing; many architectural-term queries drifted to GFRP bars and were re-tagged (R3788–R4009, 14 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.concrete-scc: Nov 20 backfill: SCC mix-design reviews, fly ash/GGBS/marble-dust/recycled-glass SCC, hardened-property reviews, steel-fibre and crumb-rubber SCC, Okamura-era funnel-test and in-situ wall papers, Spanish/Portuguese self-compacting concrete studies (R3579–R4045, 31 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.concrete-polymer-refractory: Nov 20 backfill: polymer concrete reviews (unsaturated polyester; epoxy/polyester/vinyl ester), polymer concrete modulus and damping, PET-based polyester precast, polymer-modified concrete in sulfuric acid, epoxy-modified repair mortar, spinel and nano-bonded refractory castables, sulfur concrete for lunar/planetary construction (R3784–R4022, 17 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.concrete-circular: Nov 20 backfill: recycled-aggregate concrete reviews (2000–2017 applications, durability, RCA properties), long-term and field-RCA studies, carbonated RCA, crushed brick/C&D aggregates, waste tyre rubber and polymeric wastes, French/Spanish/Portuguese recycled-aggregate studies and retry-list RCA theses/guides (Leite 2001, Swedish VTI Återvägen, Wesche & Schulz 1984) (R3575–R4041, 42 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.concrete-pavement-pervious: Nov 20 backfill: pervious concrete reviews and mix-design methods (aggregate size, paste thickness, silica fume, rice-husk ash, recycled/waste-glass/rubber aggregates, geopolymer), Elsevier Pervious Concrete Pavements (2025), freeze–thaw critical saturation, short-panel pavements (2026) and early 1915–1918 concrete-road bulletins (R3573–R4044, 21 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.concrete-repair-grout-overlay: Nov 20 backfill: corrosion-inhibitor state-of-the-art and reviews (calcium nitrite, organic/green inhibitors), repair-substrate bond test methods and moisture preparation, UHPFRC rehabilitation and its climate impact, geopolymer repair material, FRP strengthening reviews, German concrete-repair (Betoninstandsetzung) books and grout concrete (R3826–R3967, 24 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.concrete-precast-insitu-print: Nov 20 backfill: precast seismic connections and unbonded post-tensioned precast columns/walls, precast segmental bridge columns, precast quality assurance by laser scanning/BIM, first RPC precast footbridge (1999), 3D concrete printing reviews and geopolymer print bond, precast bathroom pods LCA, PN-EN 15037-1 beam-and-block floors (R3679–R4017, 19 records). DOI/abstract level only.
